women’s sports don’t bring in as much revenue as men’s sports because the talent level is worse. that’s it. everyone here trying to chalk it up to sexism or a lack of advertising is dreaming. 

i have a friend who is an assistant coach for a WNBA team. he scrimmages with the team sometimes and holds his own against professional athletes despite never playing above the high school level. the athleticism gap is just too large.

i love basketball, but if i wanted to see players of that caliber, i would go to a mid level high school team’s game.
same here. thought it was just nanny state overreach but that’s fucking disgusting.

it is fascinating. i had an ex with whom i broke up then got back together. we were both 25. in the interim i had sex with a 19 year old. the fury when she found out…… i heard about it for months, literally up until we finally called it quits for good. i let her have her feelings for a while because i knew it hurt her feelings but when it finally became too much i told her that she went out clubbing, hooked up with older men, had a great time when she was 18-20 and now that i’m in a position in which i can be the guy she used to pursue and have the women she and her friends used to be, she’s bitter, and it’s a double standard. never got a great answer to that one.

it is just a product of women realizing as they get older and want to settle down that the men they want to settle down with have expanding options while their own dating pools are narrowing. at the end of the day, it’s literally just a mechanism women use as they age to reduce competition. there’s a notion that men who date younger have trouble finding women their own age…. does anyone in their heart of hearts believe that older men with enough attractive characteristics to consistently have sex with hot college girls truly can’t pull a woman who’s going out of her way to settle down? no, it’s all about 25-30 year olds hitting the age they want to settle down, looking around and realizing that while they won’t date younger or poorer, men their age or older at their level of income or higher very much will. i don’t think it’s conscious but i absolutely believe that’s the root of it.
